title: Cognitive OS Domain Definition
description: A configurable life domain used to categorize entries and describe domain-specific fields.

name.description: Stable human-readable domain name used by entries.

icon.description: Short icon identifier or Unicode symbol used by review clients.

color.description: CSS-compatible color token, preferably a six-digit hexadecimal color.

schema_json.description: JSON object containing optional domain-specific validation rules.

active.description: Whether new entries may currently be assigned to this domain.
